title: Keep ordinary block compression and mean dynamics charged
statement: For acquired K and psi preparation, ordinary compression already block-encodes Hbar=(I tensor <psi|)K(I tensor |psi>) at its normalization;LCU can encode K-Hbar tensor I without a numeric mean or normalized postselection. The real physical sqrt(lambda)Hbar remains in the same generator unless an actual scalar commutator is removed. Sparse Pauli lists permit separately earned exact stabilizer numeric means;arbitrary Boolean diagonal numeric means can contain counting problems,which does NOT make their block encodings unavailable. Learning source transitions does not acquire future coupling K. No practical crossover/priority is inferred.
